title: heliotropium saltianum
intro: Heliotropium saltianum, commonly known as Saltbush or Heliotropium, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). The plant is known to possess several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Heliotropium saltianum include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
